Dunsparce

Normal

Johto · Generation 2

Dunsparce is a Normal-type Land Snake Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 14 kg. It evolves into Dudunsparce. Its highest base stat is HP (100), with a base stat total of 415.
